title: Old Amber 155/165 Reverse Holo Pokemon 151 Scarlet & Violet Korean sv2a
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
This Old Amber card is a must-have for any serious Pokémon TCG collector. With a beautiful Reverse Holo finish and a rare 155/165 card number, this Trainer-Item card is sure to be a valuable addition to your collection. The card features the character Old Amber, who is depicted in stunning detail on the card stock material. 

This Korean language card was manufactured by Nintendo in Japan and is part of the Scarlet & Violet set. It is suitable for players aged 8 and above and is not considered vintage. The card is perfect for use in the Pokémon League convention/event and is sure to impress any fan of the game.
